translations.55e3a817099ec43625f3dddb: Select a portion of the explanations to highlight or take notes.
translations.b5669cb918fcbbf37da4794d: A model only becomes an agent when it has a goal and tools to act; without tools, it only talks.
translations.f556d487c78fcf5bad675644: ⟪P0⟫Model⟪P1⟫the brain that reads and writes text.
translations.5d35fd7c5be19675ff9021e0: ⟪P0⟫Tool⟪P1⟫the hand that acts, like a calendar, spreadsheet, or WhatsApp.
translations.72a07b193cf3a756e1dea110: ⟪P0⟫Result⟪P1⟫what’s left in the world after execution.
translations.df0c308c6b5d224616c4468b: ✓ Always ask: does it only answer, or does it also act somewhere?
translations.c454849a770c644f50d9d9e5: ✗ Calling any chat conversation with a chatbot that only returns text an “agent.”
translations.c6637eb5161ba11903cf96a3: List three tasks from your work and mark for each one whether AI would only answer or would need to execute something.
translations.0548665df9a646add9921efb: Example: “summarize a contract” is answering; “send a payment reminder” is executing, because it uses a tool and talks to people outside. The execution tasks are the ones that require more care with limits.
translations.802da9cd9b5d13848d007238: The turning point: before you executed; now you manage
translations.e4e5da31d07a59f3f37da590: Your work moves from execution and spreads across four management stages, before and after the agent acts.
translations.62a47d94b6df312071b4c774: ⟪P0⟫Context⟪P1⟫provide the rules and the current situation.
translations.2318fc433ffe69620611a959: ⟪P0⟫Delegate⟪P1⟫hand over the task with clear boundaries.
translations.798d887c2248d036925329ec: ⟪P0⟫Evaluate⟪P1⟫check the result and correct the course.
translations.ef03e8cd776aff3c63defd47: Define the intention: identify the initial condition.
translations.03d8c4eb07e8846bf945c946: Organize the context: apply the described decision.
translations.d97e5d8cd4ddb2978c8dc428: Delegate: verify the effect in the example.
translations.4b77ea22103c2b7e0d6e8c8c: Supervise and assess: record the output evidence.
translations.94c3be0b2b2a29ee2681b513: ✓ Set aside time on your calendar to review what the agent did.
translations.2822d03656cff4758c1920c3: ✗ Delegate and disappear, assuming the agent will guess what you forgot to say.
translations.8860d64c3ba0e1ce9e3ab197: Think of an employee you trained. Write down what you explained on day one.
translations.2f41be17fc49e733891d2910: This is the context an agent also needs. The difference is that the employee infers what was left implicit; the agent only knows what’s written.
